description_en: Please note: This Phalcāhas been dismantled in 2023. Apparently, there are plans to rebuild the monument because of pressure from community members due to the ritual importance of the Phalcā for the Pānejus.Before it was demolished, the south-facing Phalcāwith seven bays was located to the north-west of the Javalakhhel roundabout. No historical records regarding the establishment of this Phalcācould be made available. This Phalcā was barely in use: A tea stall and a cleaning service used the platform for storage. However, Pānejupriests perform a tantric worship (Nakiṃ Khākegu Pūjā) in front of the Phalcā at midnight before the day of the arrival of Matsyendranātha’s Bhotojātrā during the Bungadhya procession. This worship is concluded in front of the chariot. At the end of the Bhotojātrā procession, the priests sit in the Phalcā and divide up their shares from the offerings made to them.A small hut made of corrogated metal sheets is located next to the Jāvalākhela Phalcā 3. About 20 wheels from previous Matsyendranātha chariots are stored here.
description_ne: जावलाखेल स्थित खानेपानी संस्थानको भवन अगाडि यो फल्चा अवस्थित छ । दक्षिणाभिमुख फल्चामा सात कवलहरू रहेका छन् । फल्चामा यसको निर्माण एवं जीर्णोद्धारबारे जानकारी पाउन सकिने कुनै अभिलेख प्राप्त छैन । जीर्ण अवस्थामा देखिने फल्चाको पश्चिमी कवलको एक थामो लड्न लागेको छ । कुनै निकायबाट पहलकदमी नहुँदा फल्चा दुरवस्थामा छ । मत्स्येन्द्रनाथको भोटो जात्राको अघिल्लो मध्य रातमा पानेजुहरूबाट यस फल्चा अगाडिबाट तान्त्रिक पूजा (नकिं खाकेगु पूजा) सुरु गरी रथ भएको स्थानमा पुगी पूजा समापन गर्ने गरिन्छ । भोटोजात्राको दिन रथमा चढाइएका प्रसाद यस फल्चामा जम्मा गरी हकवाला पानेजुहरूको समूहले बराबर भाग लागाई लिने गर्दछन् ।
monument_assessment: Heavily damaged (collapsed, demolished, major cracks and structural damages)
identified_threats: Erosion, Wall cracks, Missing stones at plinths, Water damages
